callable_semantics_note: Official inStrain 1.9.1 scaffold_info output distinguishes breadth (>=1 mapped read) from breadth_minCov (positions with >= min_cov depth, verified default 5x in inStrain 1.9.1 argumentParser and explicitly set via --min_cov 5 in posthoc sensitivity runs). Legacy mapper field `callable_positions` computed round(length * breadth) and is preserved here as `read_covered_positions_ge1x`, while `inferred_depth_qualified_positions_ge_mincov` is derived strictly from round(length * breadth_minCov) (or reported as explicit unknown if absent). Full variant callability also depends on base quality, read ANI, and allele frequency/FDR filters. In installed inStrain 1.9.1, scaffold_info.tsv summary columns (`SNV_count`, `SNS_count`, `divergent_site_count`) are computed by `calc_snps` across `mm <= max_mm` WITHOUT filtering `cryptic == True` sites, whereas exported `<prefix>_SNVs.tsv` (`SNVprofile.get_nonredundant_snv_table`) filters `cryptic == False` BEFORE deduplicating by `(scaffold, position)`. Both counts are retained with explicit labels (`*_unfiltered_cumulative` vs `exported_non_cryptic_*` plus `cryptic_variant_site_count_excluded_from_exported_snv_table`) and validated against `raw_data/cumulative_snv_table.csv.gz`. Profile completion requires the exact terminal banner `..:: inStrain profile finished ::..` in log/log.log, and missing `*SNVs.tsv` files on disk are reported as `unknown_snv_table_missing` without inventing zero.

crosssample_sensitivity_profiles.depth_qualified_position_method: round(inStrain scaffold_info length * breadth_minCov) at min_cov=5 (explicit_cli_flag_min_cov_5); inferred depth-qualified positions (>=min_cov) only — full variant callable status also requires base quality, read pair ANI, and allele frequency/FDR filters

raw_cumulative_variant_reconciliation.source_semantics: calc_snps counts last cumulative record per position at mm<=threshold, without cryptic filter. SNVprofile.get_nonredundant_snv_table filters cryptic==False BEFORE sorting mm and keeping last per scaffold+position.

crosssample_sensitivity_profiles.read_covered_position_method: round(inStrain scaffold_info length * breadth); positions with >=1 mapped read
crosssample_sensitivity_profiles.variant_count_reconciliation_semantics: scaffold_info.tsv SNV_count/SNS_count/divergent_site_count (calc_snps in inStrain/profile/snv_utilities.py:249-272) count the last cumulative_snv_table record per position at mm<=max_mm WITHOUT filtering cryptic==True sites (where divergent_site_count = SNV_count + SNS_count + zero_allele_divergent_site_count); exported <prefix>_SNVs.tsv (SNVprofile.get_nonredundant_snv_table in inStrain/SNVprofile.py:495-510) filters cryptic==False BEFORE sorting mm and keeping last per (scaffold, position). Both counts are reproducible with distinct meanings: summary divergent_site_count = exported non-cryptic rows + excluded cryptic positions; zero exported variants does not imply zero summary sites when cryptic sites are present.
crosssample_sensitivity_profiles.variant_interpretation: sequence polymorphism (SNV_count) and fixed consensus substitutions (SNS_count) only; inferred depth-qualified positions (round(length * breadth_minCov) at >=min_cov) are necessary but not sufficient for full variant callability (which also requires base quality, read pair ANI, and allele frequency/FDR filters); variants are never evidence of recombination
